Save a grid of scatter plots for significant module-feature pairs

plot_module_scatter_grid.Rd

For each pair of columns from matA and matB whose p-value in p_mat is at or below pval, draws a scatter plot with a linear regression line and annotates it with the correlation coefficient and p-value taken from cor_mat and p_mat. The full grid is saved as an SVG file in Results/. The line is a linear fit of the values given in matA and matB. Each panel is 3.2 x 3.2 inches, so the size of the file follows from the number of panels. The column names are the axis titles; names longer than 30 characters are split over several lines at "_" or ".", and the margins are set from the number of lines.

Usage

plot_module_scatter_grid(
  matA,
  matB,
  cor_mat,
  p_mat,
  file_name,
  pval = 0.05,
  only_sig = TRUE,
  ncol = NULL,
  max_pairs = 100,
  axis_suffix = "",
  p_label = "p"
)

Arguments

matA

A numeric matrix or data frame (samples x modules) for the y-axis of each panel. compute.modules.relationship() passes the ranks for Spearman correlations, and the values corrected for batch when batch is used.

matB

A numeric matrix or data frame (samples x features) for the x-axis of each panel.

cor_mat

A numeric matrix of correlation coefficients between columns of matA (rows) and matB (columns).

p_mat

A numeric matrix of p-values corresponding to cor_mat.

file_name

Character. Base name for the output SVG file (saved to Results/<file_name>_scatter_grid.svg).

pval

Numeric. P-value cutoff for displaying a pair. Default 0.05.

only_sig

Logical. If TRUE (default), only pairs with p <= pval are plotted.

ncol

Integer or NULL. Number of columns in the plot grid. If NULL, set to ceiling(sqrt(n_pairs)).

max_pairs

Integer. Maximum number of panels: if there are more pairs, only the strongest correlations are drawn (with a message). Default 100.

axis_suffix

Character added to the axis titles after the column names (e.g. " (rank)"). Default "".

p_label

Character. Name of the values of p_mat written in each panel (e.g. "padj" for adjusted p-values). Default "p".

Value

Called for its side effect (saves SVG); returns NULL invisibly.
